description: This file defines a SwiftUI View component called SelectionStateIndicator that visually indicates selection state with icons, and an extension on View for styling selectable row elements, including hover and selection backgrounds.

classes.name: SelectionStateIndicator
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that shows a checkmark or an arrow icon based on the selection state.

methods.name: openClawSelectableRowChrome
methods.description: A View extension method that applies padding, background, and border styles for selectable rows, based on selection and hover states.

methods.name: openClawRowBackground
methods.description: A private helper function determining the row background color based on selection and hover states.
